defects.description: Admission returns allowed without reserving a shared slot when a worker has no connection yet.
defects.why_missed: S9(a): start a job, hold its index write, then submit another worker and observe admission before releasing either job. Existing worker tests explicitly warm their connection; registry admission is correct on its own.

defects.description: Pending delegates to the claiming selector, so preview reserves profiles and increments attempts before apply can select them.
defects.why_missed: S9(a): preview, inspect stored state, then apply and inspect the index. Existing tests exercise only apply, where claiming and incrementing attempts are required.
